# Sell Smart Austin

> Sell Smart Austin helps Central Texas homeowners sell a house three ways: a cash offer as is, a full service MLS listing for top dollar, or a structured middle path between the two. Sellers see the projected net of every option before deciding. Founded and run by James Konvalinka, a licensed Texas real estate agent (TREC License #831102, sponsored by MODUS Real Estate, broker license #9013412). Phone: (512) 368-1487. Service area: the Austin metro and the I-35 corridor from Waco to New Braunfels, Texas.

Key facts:
- A licensed Texas real estate agent runs every transaction, unlike most "we buy houses" companies, which are unlicensed wholesalers.
- Three options on every house: cash as is, list for top dollar, or a structured middle path. The seller picks; no path is pushed.
- Cash offers are free, written, based on real comparable sales, and carry no obligation.
- Situations handled: behind on mortgage payments or facing foreclosure, behind on property taxes or tax delinquent, inherited a house or probate property, out of state heirs and owners, houses that need major repairs, tired landlords and tenant occupied houses, vacant houses, divorce, relocation, downsizing.
- Beyond cash purchases: full service MLS listings, free licensed-agent home valuations, and structured sale paths when they fit the situation.
- Sellers never need to repair, clean, or clear out a house for the cash path. Remote and mail-away closings available.
- Real project photos and real people only. No stock photos.

## Pages
- [Home](https://sellsmartaustin.com/): the three options explained, real renovation projects, FAQ
- [Get a Cash Offer](https://sellsmartaustin.com/cash-offer/): written cash offer within 24 hours, no repairs, no fees, no showings
- [What's Your Home Worth](https://sellsmartaustin.com/home-value/): free valuation by a licensed agent using actual comparable sales, not an algorithm
- [Inherited Property](https://sellsmartaustin.com/inherited-property/): sell an inherited Texas house from out of state, without clearing it out, alongside your probate attorney
- [Facing Foreclosure](https://sellsmartaustin.com/facing-foreclosure/): the real Texas foreclosure timeline and every option before the sale date, including the ones that don't involve us
- [Behind On Property Taxes](https://sellsmartaustin.com/behind-on-property-taxes/): back taxes get paid from sale proceeds at closing, plus payment plans and the 65+/disabled deferral explained honestly
- [Selling A Rental](https://sellsmartaustin.com/sell-rental-property/): sell tenant-occupied with the lease honored, or wait and list vacant, with the net shown both ways
- [Vacant House](https://sellsmartaustin.com/sell-vacant-house/): carrying costs, as-is sale with no cleanout, and when keeping it protected is the better move
